# Hosea Chapter 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 332r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/HOS_011_page_001.jpg

---

**11:1** When Yisra'el [was] a-youth [na'ar] I-loved-him [ahavtihu], and-from-Mitsrayim I-called [qarati] my-son [livni].

**11:2** They-called [qare'u] to-them — so they-went from-their-face; to-the-Ba'alim [Baalim] they-sacrificed [yezbbechu], and-to-the-images [la-pesilim] they-burned-incense [yeqatteru].

**11:3** And-I [anokhi], I-taught-to-walk [tirgalti] Efrayim [Ephraim]; I-took-them [qacham] on my-arms [zero'otai]; but-they-did-not know [lo yade'u] that I-healed-them [refa'tim].

**11:4** With-cords [be-chavlei] of-a-man [adam] I-drew-them [emshekhem], with-bands [ba-avotot] of-love [ahavah]; and-I-was [va'ehyeh] to-them as-those-who-lift [ke-merimei] a-yoke [ol] from-on their-jaws [lecheihem], and-I-bent-down [at] to-him [and] fed-him [okhil].

**11:7** And-my-people [ammi] [are] hung-up [telu'im] on-turning-away [li-meshuvati] from-me; and-to the-Most-High [el al] they-call [yiqra'uhu] — together [yachdav] he-will-not raise-them [lo yeromem].

**11:8** How can-I-give-you-up [ettenekha], Efrayim? How can-I-hand-you-over [amaggenkha], Yisra'el? How can-I-make-you like-Admah [Admah]? How can-I-treat-you like-Tsevoyim [Zeboiim]? My-heart [libbi] is-turned [nehpakh] upon-me [be-qirbi]; together [yachdav] my-compassions [nichumay] are-kindled [nikhmaru].

**11:9** I-will-not carry-out [lo e'eseh] the-burning [charon] of-my-anger [appi]; I-will-not return [lo ashuv] to-destroy [le-shachet] Efrayim; for God [El] I [am] and-not a-man [ish]; the-Holy-One [Qadosh] in-your-midst [be-qirbkha]; and-I-will-not come [lo avo] in-wrath [be-ir].

**11:10** After YHWH they-will-walk [yelkhu]; like-a-lion [ke-aryeh] he-will-roar [yish'ag]; for he will-roar, and-sons [vanim] will-come-trembling [yecherdu] from-the-west [mi-yam].

**11:11** They-will-come-trembling like-a-bird [ke-tsippor] from-Mitsrayim, and-like-a-dove [ke-yonah] from-the-land of-Ashur [Assyria]; and-I-will-settle-them [vehoshavtim] in-their-houses [al-battehem]," declares YHWH.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "out of Egypt I called my son":** Matthew 2:15 quotes this verse as fulfilled in Jesus's return from Egypt. In context, it refers to the Exodus — YHWH "calling" Israel as a beloved child.

**v.3-4 — God as parent:** The most tender divine self-portrait in the prophets. YHWH taught Ephraim to walk, held him by the arms, drew him with "cords of love," lifted the yoke from his jaw, bent down to feed him. The imagery is of a parent with a toddler.

**v.8-9 — "How can I give you up?":** The theological center of the book. YHWH's anger *should* destroy Israel (as it destroyed Admah and Zeboiim alongside Sodom and Gomorrah). But God's heart is "turned within him" — the Hebrew *nehpakh* is visceral, physical. "For I am God, and not a man" — divine compassion exceeds human anger.

*— EMET*
